text_block_list.text:
While out and about, we decided to visit the aquarium!
Apparently, this facility's main attraction is its killer whale tank—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ah, over there! The orca exhibit!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? The atmosphere feels kind of strange—

text_block_list.name: Orca
text_block_list.text:
Kyuiiiiii-!
Gyui, gyui-gyururururu...!!

...For some reason, the air around the orca tank feels
extremely tense. I can even hear the orca making
uncharacteristic cries...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter, both of you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um... It's my fault.
I put the orca on guard, so—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Orcas are top tier among marine life.
I came to watch and learn from their strength.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However, as I watched, I was inspired by
the killer whale's sheer dominance, and
I ended up getting fired up without meaning to—

text_block_list.name: Orca
text_block_list.text:
—Kh!?
*whiiiiine*...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I must have radiated an intimidating aura.
...My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Negative...
The "fault" also belongs to Neo Universe—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Connect"... "DEON" is 『Orca』.
Requesting "response." Beep, beep, beep, beep———

text_block_list.name: Orca
text_block_list.text: ...!! GYUUUUUUUUN!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Launch failure, transmission failed.
The 'Orca' radio wave status is "DCOMF"...

The two of them seem very disappointed
at not being able to see the orcas up close.
Still, with the animals being that wary—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's all right, you two.
As long as there's love, you can become great friends!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Will love... reach them?
When I'm the very one who put them on guard...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Please don't deny who you are.
First, learn to love yourself.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: A heart that loves both oneself and one's rivals—I believe that is truly what it means to be "truly strong."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
As long as there's love,
Mr. Orca will understand.
I'm sure he'll come over to us, too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"And Universe-san too.
Surely you came here wanting to become friends with the orcas as well, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Still, the optimal 'method of transmission' remains unknown... Words... will not reach—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
There is a love that can be conveyed
even without exchanging a single word.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Just facing each other side-by-side like this, Universe-san,
I can feel your love."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Your heart radiates such a wonderful...
and gentle warmth.
I'm sure the orca will be able to feel it too."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so!
Why don't you try showing some affection first?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Whatever love wells up from within your hearts—
anything goes! Let's give it a try!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Love... The love that I know is...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —This is it. The fan that all the supporters wave for me.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Love"... "Halves"...
Then, for Orca's "resupply,"
I "propose" we "halve" the "water jelly."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I think it's wonderful!
Come on, let's deliver the love of you two♪

text_block_list.name: Orca
text_block_list.text: Kyururuunâ¡â¡â¡

The orca approached the two of them!
It seems it's finally let down its guard.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Both of your feelings came through loud and clear, full of loveâ¡
Love begets love, after allâª
choice_data_list: Wanna go try the feeding experience?
I want to get a good look at the orca's face too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! Looks like it's happening on the upper floor.
Universe-san, let's split it as proof of being buddies with the orca! ♡

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Will you... "split it in half"?
With Neo Universe...

text_block_list.name: Orca
text_block_list.text: Kyuiii~~♡♡

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! Sfera!
Then should we split the "resupply" fish in "half" too?
choice_data_list: Maybe we really shouldn't do that, though?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
From my hand! Let's ask the zookeeper
if I can feed them directly from my hand!
Even just that should be enough to convey my love...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I'd love to see the cute orca's face from the front too.
Duramente-san, shall we ask together?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ready, and! Show me your face~~♡

text_block_list.name: Orca
text_block_list.text: Kyui, kyuikyui~~♡

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Killer whales are so cute... Does this mean the truly strong
also possess cuteness as well...?!
Treated to countless adorable antics from the orca, a truly heartwarming bond was formed.
